meta.description: TAYA (They Ask, You Answer) blog content plan for The Boiler Doctor — 100 rows (99 blog posts + 1 internal-link fix). Read by the weekly automated content-drafting task to pick the next post(s) to write. Do not reorder rows; update status/slug/published_path/drafted_date in place as posts are drafted.
meta.selection_rule: Pick the next N rows with status == not_started, ordered by phase_num ascending, then priority (High before Med before Low), then id ascending. Skip any row with content_type == "Internal Link Fix" when selecting posts to draft — handle it as a one-off site-hygiene task instead, separately, if its status is still not_started.
